summary.headline: Astrological Questions on War and Childbirth
summary.text: Chapters 50–70 of an astrological question manual cover thieves and bodily marks, stolen garments, inceptions, lunar affliction, markets and slaves, conception and childbirth, and military questions about armies and war. Chapter 66 is attributed to Theophilo of Edessa, with cross-references to Codex Vindobonensis 2 and Codex Parisinus 2417.
